term.label: Phage_RNA_Polymerase_Promoter

definition.text: A region (DNA) to which Bacteriophage RNA polymerase binds, to begin transcription.

comments: former parent RNA_polymerase_promoter SO:0001203 was merged with promoter SO:0000167 in Aug 2020 as part of GREEKC.

mostRecent.subject: Obsoleted SO:0001203 RNA_polymerase_promoter, merged it with promoter SO:0000167. Child terms of RNA_polymerase_promoter were moved to eukaryotic_promoter SO:0002221, prokaryotic_promoter SO:0002222 or viral_promoter SO:0002311. Updated as part of GREEKC initiative. See GitHub Issue #492.
